dct_description_sm:
Playground Equipment categorized by appropriate age group: Toddler (age 2-5), All Ages (age 2-12), Older Child (age 5-12).

Includes: swings, slides, climbing apparatus, natural play areas, stepping stones, merry go round, play house, play panel, sand play, see saw, spinners, spring toys, teeter totters, zip line, and other play structures.

Data are updated by city staff as needed, and copied to the Open Data Portal on a weekly basis. The "Last Updated" date shown on our Open Data Portal refers to the last time the data schema was modified in the portal, or any changes were made to this description.  We update our data through daily scripts which does not trigger the "last updated" date to change.

Note: Attributes represent each field in a dataset, and some fields will contain information such as ID numbers.  As a result some visualizations on the tabs on our Open Data page will not be relevant.
